About This Home

This stunning Altadore showhome represents the very best of inner-city luxury living. Featuring a thoughtfully designed open main floor, chef-inspired kitchen with premium appliances, and a seamless indoor-outdoor living experience.

The upper floor offers three generously sized bedrooms including a primary suite with spa-like ensuite and walk-in closet. The fully developed basement provides suite potential with its own entrance, making this home as versatile as it is beautiful.

Located on a tree-lined street in the heart of Altadore, steps from parks, schools, and the vibrant Marda Loop community.
